headline: Eurocash prepares Polish online grocery unit Frisco for potential 2027 IPO
summary: Retail group Eurocash initiated preparations to list its e-commerce supermarket subsidiary Frisco on the Warsaw Stock Exchange, with an initial public offering targeted no earlier than 2027.
why: Eurocash is one of Poland's dominant wholesale retail groups, expanding its footprint in e-grocery operations.

impacts.name: Eurocash
impacts.why: Eurocash initiated structural preparation to spin off its online subsidiary via IPO.
